_doc: Outcome restrictions (harness/outcome_restriction.py): an UNRESTRICTED outcome never pools a row restricted by attribution or cause; the markers are verbatim phrasings of the restriction.

Adverse events leading to discontinuatio.definition: any adverse event leading to discontinuation of the trial regimen, whatever its attribution or cause

examples_refused.FOURIER: Thought to be related to the study agent and leading to discontinuation of study regimen | 226 (1.6) | 201 (1.5)
examples_refused.ODYSSEY OUTCOMES: Injection-site reactions (itching, redness, or swelling) were usually mild and self- limited and led to discontinuation of the trial regimen in 26 patients in the alirocumab group, at a median of 8.3 months after randomization, and in 3 patients in the placebo group.
